Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

managelidar 0.1.6

Package cleanup

  • Fixed raw_to_processed(), which was non-functional end-to-end: it called a nonexistent internal function (read_log_entries()), and a duplicated block re-opened an overview file the first copy had just deleted.
  • Fixed set_names() silently passing wrong arguments to check_names() due to a positional-argument mismatch after check_names()’s signature changed.
  • Fixed write_gpkg() erroring on its own documented metrics = usage (a character vector), and create_vpc_enriched()’s empty-VPC guard never firing (length() vs nrow()).
  • Standardized error handling package-wide on cli.
  • Converged inconsistent return types (get_*()/is_*() functions now consistently return a plain data.frame) and other naming/consistency cleanups.
  • Fixed several robustness gaps: check_names()’s runtime boundary download now fails with an actionable message instead of crashing; get_penetration() handles headers with fewer return bins gracefully.
  • DESCRIPTION now declares all packages actually used (cli, mirai, httpuv, rlang, viridis, methods, stats, grDevices, etc.) and drops unused ones (rlas, data.table); the R version floor is corrected to R >= 4.1 (required by the native pipe).
  • Added an initial tests/testthat/ suite covering the fixes above, plus the get_*()/is_*() metadata-query family and filtering functions.

Documentation

  • Fixed drift in vignettes/raw-to-processed.Rmd against the current raw_to_processed() behavior (missing log_dir parameter, incorrect output directory structure, missing skipped_locked status value).
  • Filled in the README’s empty License section.
